items.description: New Zealand annual immigration continues to show signs of a tentative recovery, rising to a 17-month high in June as fewer people departed.

items.description: Asian stocks gained as further evidence of moderating US inflation and a pullback in oil prices reinforced bets that the Federal Reserve will refrain from raising interest rates next month.

items.title: Reddit Shares Surge on S&P 500 Inclusion Later This Month
